steps.title: Present Continuous
steps.html:
FormExample
Positiveam / is / are + -ingShe's buying clothes.
Negativeam not / isn't / aren't + -ingThey aren't working today.
QuestionAm / Is / Are + person + -ingWhat are you doing?
Short answerYes, I am. / No, I'm not.

Two parts are needed: am / is / are AND the -ing form. Neither works alone.

Spelling: make → making, run → running, study → studying.

Learners often write I buying or I am buy. Both halves have to be there.

Lesson 19 compares this with the Present Simple.
